bibliographic-data.invention-title: APPAREILS, PROCÉDÉS ET RÉACTIFS DE DOSAGE

nplcit.text: - ELI PELI, "Contrast in Complex Images", Journal of the Optical Society of America, (19901010), pages 2032 - 2040
- PORTERWEIR, J. Cell Physiol., (19660000), vol. 67, pages 51 - 64
- HOCHMAN et al., Biochemistry, (19730000), vol. 12, pages 1130 - 1135

abstract.p: A light detection system adapted to read single-well addressable multi-well plates, and a method of imaging using the light detection system are described. The light detection system, and the method may be employed in conducting automated analysis in a multi-well plate assay format.
